title.narrative: Through UNICEF’s technical and financial support in 2024, about 50,937 people in Eritrea (target: 110,000), including vulnerable communities affected by drought and conflict, received basic water and hygiene (WASH) services. 35,637 le (target: 60,000) gained access to basic drinking water and 15,300 people (target: 50,000) received hygiene education.
